questions.prompt: The rapid Rhine, swollen with rains, terrified the anxious farmers.
questions.answer: Rhēnus rapidus, imbribus tumidus, agricolās sollicitōs terruit.

questions.prompt: The cold north wind, blowing from the mountains, scattered the sailors' ships.
questions.answer: Aquilō frīgidus, ā montibus flāns, nāvēs nautārum dispersit.

questions.prompt: In April the poet praised the gentle rivers of his homeland.
questions.answer: Aprīlī poēta lēnēs patriae amnēs laudāvit.

questions.prompt: The east wind, to be feared by all, drove the fleet toward Africa.
questions.answer: Eurus, ab omnibus timendus, classem ad Āfricam ēgit.

questions.prompt: The queen, mourning her dead son, gave gifts to the gods.
questions.answer: Rēgīna, mortuum fīlium lūgēns, deīs dōna dedit.

questions.prompt: The farmer's mother, wise and pious, feared the anger of the goddess.
questions.answer: Māter agricolae, sapiēns et pia, īram deae timēbat.

questions.prompt: The sailor, though brave, was weeping at his mother's grave.
questions.answer: Nauta, quamquam fortis, ad mātris sepulcrum flēbat.

questions.prompt: The poet, a famous man, praised the beauty of the maiden.
questions.answer: Poēta, vir clārus, virginis pulchritūdinem laudāvit.

questions.prompt: The divine will punished the impious man's dreadful crime.
questions.answer: Nūmen dīvīnum nefandum hominis facinus pūnīvit.

questions.prompt: The old woman, full of complaints, hated the servant's obedience.
questions.answer: Anus, querēlārum plēna, servī obsequium ōderat.

questions.prompt: Filth and old age had weakened the limbs of the sick king.
questions.answer: Sordēs et vetustās membra rēgis aegrī dēbilitāverant.

questions.prompt: Angry at the poison, the girl mourned her dying brother.
questions.answer: Venēnō īrāta, puella morientem frātrem lūgēbat.

questions.prompt: In March the soldiers crossed the swift Tiber by night.
questions.answer: Mārtiō mīlitēs celerem Tiberim nocte trānsiērunt.

questions.prompt: The warm south wind of summer melted the deep snows.
questions.answer: Auster tepidus aestātis altās nivēs solvit.

questions.prompt: January, harsh with cold, was holding the wide fields in ice.
questions.answer: Iānuārius, frīgore asper, lātōs agrōs glaciē tenēbat.

questions.prompt: The gentle Seine was flowing through the lands of the Gauls.
questions.answer: Sēquana lēnis per Gallōrum terrās fluēbat.

questions.prompt: The king's daughter, betrothed to a god, feared the transformation.
questions.answer: Rēgis fīlia, deō dēstināta, metamorphōsin timēbat.

questions.prompt: The nurse kissed the sleeping boy with tender love.
questions.answer: Nūtrīx dormientem puerum tenerō amōre ōsculāta est.

questions.prompt: Stiff with cold, the aged farmer was cursing the winter winds.
questions.answer: Frīgore rigēns, senex agricola hībernōs ventōs exsecrābātur.

questions.prompt: The messenger announced the success of the war to the anxious queen.
questions.answer: Nūntius bellī successum sollicitae rēgīnae nūntiāvit.

questions.prompt: A small piece of meat delighted the hungry poet.
questions.answer: Parvum copadium ēsurientem poētam dēlectāvit.

questions.prompt: The hidden poison, mixed with wine, killed the greedy king.
questions.answer: Occultum vīrus, vīnō mixtum, avidum rēgem necāvit.

questions.prompt: The winds of November scattered the withered leaves through the streets.
questions.answer: Novembris ventī āridās frondēs per viās sparsērunt.

questions.prompt: The west wind, rising at first light, carried the ships across the sea.
questions.answer: Zephyrus, prīmā lūce surgēns, nāvēs trāns mare portāvit.
